title: Songbook and Garden
author: Jude Brightwater
blurb: Vesper Winterbourne, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
